fn-compass-02.front: Declination east: map bearing to compass bearing?

fn-compass-03.front: Which way does declination change here each year?
fn-compass-03.back: It falls about 0.13 degrees a year.

fn-compass-04.front: 1 degree of error over 1 km misses by?
fn-compass-04.back: About 17 m. 5 degrees is 87 m, 15 degrees is 268 m.

<circle cx="40" cy="250" r="8" fill="#2f3a2b" stroke="none" stroke-width="2"/><text x="40" y="280" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">You</text><line x1="40" y1="250" x2="370" y2="250" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="372" y="272" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="end" font-weight="bold">Target, 1 km</text><line x1="40" y1="250" x2="369.196136585742" y2="226.98036366443864" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/><text x="365.196136585742" y="218.98036366443864" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#8a9a6b" text-anchor="end" font-weight="bold">1°: 17 m</text><line x1="40" y1="250" x2="363.9369705377291" y2="187.03303152574023" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/><text x="359.9369705377291" y="179.03303152574023" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="end" font-weight="bold">5°: 87 m</text><line x1="40" y1="250" x2="345.97067200703987" y2="126.37982417274904" stroke="#c92a2a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/><text x="341.97067200703987" y="118.37982417274904" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#c92a2a" text-anchor="end" font-weight="bold">15°: 268 m</text><text x="20" y="84" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#868e96" text-anchor="start">(angles drawn bigger to show)</text><text x="20" y="40" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start" font-weight="bold">Off by a few degrees, over 1 km</text><text x="20" y="62" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">How far you miss the truck</text>

fn-compass-13.back: Count every time one foot lands on a measured 100 m: flat, uphill and in brush. A backup only.

fn-compass-14.front: A swamp blocks your bearing. Box method?
fn-compass-14.back: Turn 90 degrees, count paces, walk past on your bearing, turn back 90 degrees, same count, carry on.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" role="img" aria-label="A swamp blocks your bearing. Turn 90 degrees left and count 60 paces, walk your bearing past the swamp, turn 90 degrees right and count the same 60 paces back, then carry on.">

fn-compass-16.back: 220. Add 180 if under 180, take 180 if over.

fn-compass-17.front: Paper NTS grid lines near Heffley Creek: true north?
fn-compass-17.back: No. Grid north is about 2.5 degrees east of true north there, so the needle is about 12.7 degrees east of the grid (85%).
